proof.text: Take degree zero in the transported enriched projection identity. Naturality of the recorded additive H-zero Hom equivalences turns Hom of the total-limit projection into postcomposition by that projection. H.scalar_hom_zero identifies the finite scalar adjunct, while the counit projection and naturality of S.reductionEvaluation rewrite the result as the pointwise clause of CoefficientHomProjection. Introducing P, N, hN, h and n then proves the forall statement.
